description: Prices a physical letter (printed, enveloped and posted by Courio) and returns a quote_id. Free and commits to nothing: no account, no payment, nothing is mailed. Give the service level, sender and recipient postal addresses, and the document (pdf_base64, pdf_url, or plain/markdown text). The price is in EUR including VAT (set currency to "USD" to also see a USD price), fixed for 24 hours. The document is checked and content-moderated; a problem comes back as an error with a hint. Quotes are capped per day (limit_exceeded with retry_after): reuse a quote_id rather than re-quoting. Service levels: "standard" (ordinary mail, no proof), "tracked" (tracking only), "registered" (registered mail: proof of deposit), "registered_ar" (registered with acknowledgement of receipt: proof of delivery, the one to use for legal notices). The quote gives the estimated delivery time (estimated_delivery_days). Next step: show the price, the legal product and the terms of sale (terms_url) to the human, then call send_letter if they agree.
name: quote_letter
title: Get a free quote for a letter
